mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 7.5% signals improving labor market conditions and rising consumer confidence, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 7.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or interaction term coefficient is negative with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-crisis recovery regime, a rising inflation rate above 2.5% y/y signals improving economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances during post-crisis recovery when CPIAUCSL y/y change exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production below 100.0 indicates weakening economic output, which reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime, a further increase in unemployment triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to deteriorating economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher absolute level of retail sales indicates strong consumer spending, which directly supports corporate revenue growth and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is above its 3-month average, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate decline below 0.25% signals aggressive monetary easing in response to economic stress, which immediately boosts equity market sentiment and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS falls below 0.25%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
